item.title: US life expectancy hit an all-time high in 2024, CDC says
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. life expectancy rose to 79 years in 2024 — the highest mark in American history. It's the result of not only the dissipation of the COVID-19 pandemic, but also waning death rates from all the nation's top killers, including heart disease, cancer and drug overdoses. item.title: Consistently snowy winter yields perfect snowmobile season in Central New York
item.description: Central New York is experiencing some of the best snowmobiling conditions in years due to the steady snowfall and extended cold temperatures, resulting in increased sales for local snowmobile businesses.

item.title: CNY SPCA protestors shocked and relieved by board's resignation
item.description: The CNY SPCA Board of Directors resigned after staff, volunteers, and community members protested for change due to issues with the shelter, including insufficient veterinary care, cruel conditions for animals, and overworked staff.
